tagline.en_US: Redis’s official visual tool for browsing Redis data, running commands and using diagnostics. It starts as a standalone service; connect it to Redis servers after opening the interface.

description.en_US: Redis Insight is a visual management tool and graphical user interface for Redis databases. It allows you to browse, filter, and edit key-value data structures including strings, hashes, lists, sets, streams, and JSON. The application also includes tools for diagnostics, command profiling, slow log analysis, and query visualization.
